title: A Comparative Analysis of Vulnerability Management Tools: Evaluating Nessus, Acunetix, and Nikto for Risk-Based Security Solutions
reasoning: The paper is a technical comparison of cybersecurity vulnerability management tools (Nessus, Acunetix, Nikto, and OWASP ZAP) based on performance metrics such as detection accuracy and cost-effectiveness.
